title: Mem-Forever: a Git-native persistent memory layer for AI agents
description: Every AI tool forgets a user when the session closes. Mem-Forever keeps the memory in the user's own Git repository as small Markdown files with OKF frontmatter and iLang declarations that a person can read and a machine can parse, so preferences, decisions and lessons survive across sessions, tools and models. Version 2.0 turns the repository into a portable agent brain: a bootloader any tool reads first, a hand-off note that says what was done and what comes next, one file per memory, and an age-encrypted vault for keys, with a single-file Python tool to check, migrate, install, build the message a chat AI with no tools needs, and review a hand-off another model wrote before it is merged. It needs no server and no account: create the repository from the template and point the agent at it. Version 2.1 makes the README the engineering book: copy it into any agent and it can carry it out; the hand-off review accepts a partial write-back. Documentation in nine languages.
